Message:
The laws of the People of
the Sand are absolute.
Breaking any law is unforgivable.

But that day,
I broke a law
for the first time.

I found an intruder
within our territory,
a poison spider at her feet.

It would be dangerous
to leave her there,
so I shouted a warning.

But instead of leaving,
the intruder came closer to me.

Without thinking,
I shot an arrow,
taking out the poison spider.

But now this meant...
that I saved the intruder...
I-In times like these,
I should just pretend
I did nothing and leave!

“My name is Ayse...!
Thank you for saving me...!”

When someone
introduces themselves,
you must introduce
yourself in return—
that is a law too.
So, I would not be
doing a bad thing...

That was my first meeting
with my secret friend—
Ayse.
